name: BIKE_MLThre
full_name: BIKE_MLThre: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Threshold-Selection Variant of BIKE

hardness_problems.name: quasi-cyclic syndrome decoding
hardness_problems.notes: Ciphertext/error recovery hardness over QC-MDPC codes.

technical_classification.mathematical_structure: R=F_2[X]/(X^r-1), QC-MDPC secret parity-check pair and fixed-weight error vector
technical_classification.kem_construction: BIKE-style implicit-rejection KEM with re-encryption/consistency check
technical_classification.claimed_security_target: 128/256/512-bit target categories with DFR at most 2^-lambda

common_parameters.noise_or_error_distribution: constant-weight error pair (e0,e1) of total Hamming weight t
common_parameters.error_correction: BGF-derived iterative bit-flipping decoder with learned residual threshold selector
common_parameters.representation: binary circulant blocks; compact sparse-secret option; fixed quantized model or lookup-table decoder profile

other.model_profile: must be fixed per interoperable instance

claimed_advantages.summary: A learned residual threshold controller is claimed to improve decoder reliability and reduce DFR with small local inference overhead.
Learning is confined to one decoder threshold-selection step, with confidence-gated fallback to the reference rule.
The selector may be a quantized MLP, lookup table or deterministic classifier fixed per instance.
The adaptive selector does not enlarge transmitted keys or ciphertexts and reuses decoder-state quantities already computed.

limitations_and_constraints.summary: Interoperability requires the exact decoder profile, trained model/table, quantization, normalization, confidence threshold, action set and clipping interval to be fixed.
The 512-bit parameter set/model is presented as a candidate requiring final independent specification and implementation reporting.
Performance was measured on an Intel Core i5-10400F, Windows 11 Pro, AVX512-labeled profiles; generalization is not established.
Additional model/lookup-table storage is implementation-dependent and excluded from protocol object sizes.

sources.notes: Scanned form; OCR plus visual review; contacts excluded.

evidence.summary: Form lists six Xidian University submitters and contact Zhenxing Niu.
Specification identifies QC-MDPC/BIKE, QC decoding and codeword-finding assumptions, and decoder-only learning.
r,w,t, target DFR, threshold rules and storage bit counts are stated.
Implementation compile-time r, secret half-weight DV, t and aliases inspected.
Innovation, simplicity, flexibility, compatibility and deployment constraints are stated.

review_notes: Bit-to-byte conversions use ceiling and retain raw bit counts.
The 256-bit threshold mismatch is preserved as a conflict.

issues.message: Specification Table 2 and reference defs.h define different baseline threshold functions for the 256-bit category.
The 512-bit profile is listed but the specification says final parameters/model must be independently specified.
Chinese names for Yongbin Liu and Haichang Gao were not legibly available in prioritized textual material.
